name: ibis-office-web
description: Build tooling for the browser version of ibisOffice (www/).

scripts.test:web: tsc --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --lib es2022,dom,dom.iterable --strict --skipLibCheck www/brand.ts www/boot.ts www/wasm-loader.ts www/local-file.ts www/pwa-register.ts www/pwa-sw-logic.ts www/spot/cose-envelope.ts www/spot/export.ts www/spot/qr.ts www/spot/tenant-setup.ts www/spot/app.ts worker/github-vault.ts worker/spot-relay.ts worker/wasm-delivery.ts worker/sw-headers.ts && node --test test/web/*.test.mjs
scripts.check:worker: wrangler types worker-configuration.d.ts --env-interface CloudflareEnv && tsc -p worker/tsconfig.json
